quarterly_data.quarter: SPIL press release: SPIL and NVIDIA Expand Optical Engine Assembly Capacity for (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: SPIL (an ASE Technology Holding subsidiary) announced a new agreement with NVIDIA to expand optical-engine assembly capacity in Taiwan for co-packaged optics (CPO): the companies started low volume production in Q3’26 and expect to ramp production by 2027 by 15X current levels, with an additional doubling by Q4 2028. Under the agreement SPIL will build out additional high-precision optical-assembly lines and collaborate with NVIDIA's engineering teams to optimize manufacturing yield and performance; SPIL will also perform testing on NVIDIA's CPO modules and support assembly for future silicon-photonics products. The agreement builds on a multi-year collaboration between the two companies.
quarterly_data.figure: production ramp by 2027 to 15X current levels; additional doubling by Q4 2028
